Implement weighted grade average calculation and display

Adds a /api/averages endpoint and an Averages page visible to all roles:

Backend (backend/):
- New averages.js route (GET /api/averages): computes arithmetic average
  of regular grades per student per assignment using SQLite AVG(). Role-
  based scoping mirrors the grades route — students see only their own
  averages; teachers must supply assignmentId (403 if they don't own it);
  admins can filter by assignmentId, studentId, or list everything.
- Registered in server.js at /api/averages.
- 11 new backend tests (node --test + supertest): auth required, student
  scoping (self-only, ignores query params, empty state), teacher
  requirementId enforcement, teacher ownership check, teacher per-student
  result, admin assignmentId filter, admin studentId filter, admin
  unfiltered list, average arithmetic correctness. All 158 backend tests
  passing (147 existing + 11 new).

Frontend (frontend/):
- New AveragesPage at /averages (visible to all roles; branches by role):
  - Student view: table of per-subject averages (subject, class, year, grade
    count, average pill + label), plus a weighted overall average in the
    page header (computed as sum(avg * count) / sum(count) so subjects with
    more grades contribute proportionally).
  - Teacher/admin view: assignment picker, then a per-student averages table
    with a class average badge in the panel header.
  - gradeLabel() maps numeric averages to labels (Excellent/Good/
    Satisfactory/Pass/Fail) matching the existing 1-5 scale.
- Added /averages to the nav (AppLayout) and route (App.tsx).
- New CSS: .summary-stat, .summary-stat--inline, .summary-stat__label,
  .summary-stat__sub, .grade-label, .panel-header-row.
- 5 new frontend tests (vitest + RTL): student table rendering with overall
  avg badge, student empty state, teacher empty-assignments state, teacher
  per-student averages load on selection, teacher class average badge. All
  55 frontend tests passing (50 existing + 5 new).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

)"
